kebab_example: aliyun paistudio list-quotas --quota-name quotajradxh43rgb --resource-type ECS --layout-mode Tree --parent-quota-id quotajradxh43rgb --quota-ids quota1ci8g793pgm,quotajradxh43rgb --workspace-ids 21345,38727 --statuses Creating --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by status --order desc --labels official=true,gpu=false --verbose true --workspace-name myshellprod --has-resource example-string --versions 1.0 --cluster-type RayCluster --gpu-type example-string --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQuotas

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by quota name. Fuzzy matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 按照QuotaName过滤，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: quota_name

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid values are Lingjun, ECS, and ACS. The default value is ECS
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The layout mode. Valid values: Tree and List
parameters.help_zh: 展示方式，可以为树形或列表
parameters.name: layout_mode

parameters.help_en:
Filters the results by parent quota ID:

- If this parameter is not specified, all quotas within the tenant are returned, including both root and child quotas.

- If this parameter is set to an empty string, all root quotas are returned.

- If a specific parent quota ID is provided, all child quotas of that parent are returned
parameters.help_zh:
按ParentQuotaId过滤：

- 不传，列出租户下所有Quota，包含根Quota和子Quota。

- 传空，列出所有的根Quota。

- 传非空，列出指定ParentQuotaId的所有子Quota
parameters.name: parent_quota_id

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of up to 100 quota IDs to filter the results. Only exact matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 逗号分隔，按QuotaIds过滤，只支持精确匹配，最多同时支持100个
parameters.name: quota_ids

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of up to 10 workspace IDs to filter the results. Only exact matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 逗号分隔，按WorkspaceIds过滤，只支持精确匹配，最多同时支持10个
parameters.name: workspace_ids

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of quota statuses to filter the results. Only exact matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 逗号分隔按照Quota Statuses过滤，只支持精确匹配
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. The minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页数据，最小值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询的分页大小，最小值为1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- QuotaName

- Status

- CPU

- Memory

- GPU

- GmtCreatedTime

- GmtModifiedTime
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的排序字段名，枚举值：

- QuotaName

- Status

- CPU

- Memory

- GPU

- GmtCreatedTime

- GmtModifiedTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values are desc and asc
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_zh: 按照Label的key和value进行过滤，多个标签使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: labels

- false: Does not return detailed information

- false：不显示详情
